title: Mass and Force Relations for Extremal E2MD Black Holes
summary: We study static extremal black holes in Einstein gravity coupled to a dilaton and two Maxwell fields with independent dilaton couplings $a$ and $b$. When $b=-1/a$ in four dimensions, a time-symmetric initial-value construction allows us to determine the masses and interaction energies of multi-black-hole configurations. On this special locus, the long-range force between any two extremal black holes vanishes.
